excerpt: Salt air near the coast corrodes the steel inside concrete as well as the fittings outside it. This guide covers the concrete, curing and hardware specification a Thiruvottiyur house needs to age well.
faqTitle: Building in Thiruvottiyur: questions owners ask

faqs.question: What do your house construction packages cost in Thiruvottiyur?
faqs.answer: Our packages are priced per sq ft of built-up area: Basic ₹2,199, Standard ₹2,399, Premium ₹2,699 and Ultra Luxury ₹3,199. Approvals, soil test, compound wall, sump and interiors are quoted separately. Near the coast we also specify extra concrete cover, tighter mix control and corrosion-resistant hardware, and show that coastal specification clearly in the quote.

faqs.question: Who approves a house plan in Thiruvottiyur?
faqs.answer: For a typical individual house in Thiruvottiyur, the building permit comes from the Greater Chennai Corporation; larger buildings go to CMDA. We prepare the drawings and handle the submission, with the approval fees quoted separately.

faqs.question: Why does curing matter more near the coast?
faqs.answer: Skimped curing leaves concrete porous, and porous concrete lets chloride from sea air reach the steel sooner. That shortens the life of the house, so our sites never cut curing time, and here it matters more than usual.

faqs.question: Why is water control important in a coastal concrete mix?
faqs.answer: A denser mix slows chloride getting in. Adding water on site to make concrete easier to place weakens that, so the water-cement ratio is controlled rather than adjusted by whoever is pouring.

faqs.question: Is a coastal specification worth the extra cost?
faqs.answer: Yes. Each upgrade is small on its own, but together they are the difference between replacing hardware in four years and in fifteen. We include them as standard in Thiruvottiyur rather than as options.
